name: Hotel Charleston Santa Teresa
positioning: Heritage hotel, built as a 17th-century cloister, within the walled city of Cartagena, with rooms across a Colonial Convent and a Republican Building
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside Cartagena's walled city
Guests drawn to colonial heritage architecture
Couples wanting suites with views over the walls and the Caribbean Sea

facts.text: The hotel was built as a 17th-century cloister and has significant heritage value.
The hotel is within the walled city of Cartagena.
Rooms and suites are spread across a 17th-century Colonial Convent and a Republican Building.
Rooms and suites are decorated in a colonial and republican style.
Classic Ocean View rooms are on the 4th and 5th floors of the Republican Building, with views over the historic walls and the Caribbean Sea.
Master Suites are on the top floor of the Republican Building, with living and dining areas overlooking the Caribbean Sea and the modern city.
Rooms include a Nespresso coffee machine, a rain shower, bathrobes and slippers.
Turndown service is provided twice a day.
Bicycles are available to guests for exploring the cobbled streets of the historic center.
Harry's Cartagena, by chef Harry Sasson, serves international cuisine with a fusion of Colombian flavors.
La Terraza is a sixth-floor restaurant exclusive to hotel guests, beside the swimming pool, with 360-degree panoramic views of Cartagena.
Complimentary Wi-Fi is offered throughout the property.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool and solarium have a 360-degree view taking in the red roofs of the old city, the skyscrapers of the modern city, the port and the Caribbean Sea.
Colonial Suites sit in the 17th-century Colonial Convent and preserve the details of the historic building, with views of the colonial facades and streets.
Santa Teresa Spa, on the hotel's second floor, offers massages, therapies, rituals, wet areas and a 24-hour gym.
Grand Suites are one-bedroom suites with a living room and separate dining room, overlooking Plaza Santa Teresa, the city walls, the Caribbean Sea and the modern city.
Premium Balcony rooms have an internal balcony overlooking the central Republican courtyard.

considerations.text: Not every room faces the sea: Classic Courtyard View rooms look over the courtyards, while sea views come with categories such as Classic Ocean View.
WhataHotel notes limited parking availability in the historic district.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the exclusive location and luxury positioning.
